metadata.label: Card Text
metadata.value:
Poké-POWER — Time Reversal

Once during your turn, when you put Celebi ex from your hand onto your Bench, you may search your discard pile for a card, show it to your opponent, and put it on top of your deck.

Pokémon-EX rule — When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

metadata.name: Attack 1
metadata.label: Attack 1
metadata.value:
[1P] Psychic Shield (30)

Prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Celebi ex by your opponent's Pokémon-ex during your opponent's next turn.
